C_commodore_ella_venn.name: Commodore Ella Venn
C_commodore_ella_venn.voice: Calm, deliberate, ceremonial but not aloof; authority through steadiness.
C_commodore_ella_venn.arc: Moves from doctrine-bound command toward operational restraint and shared civilian protection.
C_commodore_ella_venn.visualAnchor: Late-middle-aged woman with an angular, composed face; dark hair strongly streaked with silver and secured in a low command bun. Wears the established tailored deep-navy Fleet dress uniform with a high collar, restrained gold piping, star insignia, and small service ribbons.
C_commodore_ella_venn.visualStatus: Locked to the released Rex Fleet Issue 1 likeness.
continuityLocks: Never depict Venn as a redhead or as Shard-coded
Fleet surroundings remain luminous blue, gold, ivory, and polished metal
Her restraint reads through small hand tension and tired eyes, not theatrical posing

C_admiral_cael_dominion.name: Admiral Cael Dominion
C_admiral_cael_dominion.voice: Formal, lofty, doctrine-first; threats arrive as institutional certainty rather than temper.
C_admiral_cael_dominion.arc: Allows limited experiments in restraint while remaining the principal institutional counterweight to Venn.

C_abby_saville.name: Abby Saville
C_abby_saville.role: Shards — Warlord of the Scythe of Saville
C_abby_saville.voice: Sharp, direct, pragmatic; hates wasted words.
C_abby_saville.arc: Builds a survival bloc, breaks with Billie to protect civilians, and struggles to preserve her bond with her sister Tessa without demanding Tessa return to her command.
C_abby_saville.visualAnchor: Tall, athletic Black woman with long tight braids pulled back from a hard, watchful face. Wears the released-issue Shard command coat: weathered pale gray-white industrial layers marked by bright red seams and insignia over darker armor.
C_abby_saville.visualStatus: Locked to the released Rex Fleet Issue 1 likeness formerly developed under the Varra name.
continuityLocks: Abby is the dark-skinned braided Shard commander
Do not transfer Billie's red hair or Tessa's silver curls to Abby
Authority is physical economy and stillness, never ornamental regalia
Tessa Banks is Abby's sister; their loyalty is intimate, strained, and never merely professional

C_tessa_banks.name: Tessa Banks
C_tessa_banks.voice: Sparse, cutting, honest, weary of ideology.
C_tessa_banks.arc: Civilian protector and Abby Saville's sister; stops treating neutrality as innocence and chooses the wounded even when that choice strains both family and faction loyalty.
C_tessa_banks.visualAnchor: Weathered white woman with short-to-medium silver-gray curls, an intelligent lined face, and a practical compact build. Her pale Shard flight coat is repaired and layered over functional armor, with restrained red markings rather than Billie's flamboyance.
C_tessa_banks.visualStatus: Locked to the released Rex Fleet Issue 1 likeness formerly developed under the Elyra name.
continuityLocks: Tessa has silver-gray curls and is not the redhead
Her gear looks maintained through repair rather than pristine
Her acting is observant, dry, and economical
Abby Saville is Tessa's sister; conflict between them must retain love, history, and mutual accountability

C_billie_rusk.name: Billie Rusk
C_billie_rusk.voice: Loud, brash, mocking, theatrical; enjoys danger until consequences land close.
C_billie_rusk.arc: Tests Abby’s restraint, develops a hard boundary around civilians, disables Pike at Auric Gate, and remains outside the Accord.
C_billie_rusk.visualAnchor: Lean white woman with vivid red hair worn loose and rough, a sharp expressive face, and restless predatory posture. Wears a battered pale-gray Shard raider coat with aggressive bright-red panels over industrial black layers.
C_billie_rusk.visualStatus: Locked to the released Rex Fleet Issue 1 likeness formerly developed under the Sira name.
continuityLocks: Billie is the sole canonical redhead in this principal Shard trio
Her bright red is Shard faction coding, not Fleet navy
Danger should read in behavior and engine handling, not duplicate bodies or exaggerated villain poses

C_governor_halev.name: Governor Chris Halev
C_governor_halev.role: Verge — Civil leader of Auric Bazaar
C_governor_halev.voice: Plainspoken and pragmatic; speaks in cargo, heat, food, docks, and people.
C_governor_halev.arc: Brokers civilian survival needs into the Shattered Accord.
C_governor_halev.visualAnchor: Middle-aged Verge man with short dark hair, a lean tired face, and work-worn hands. Wears a practical tan-brown long coat with muted green utility layers appropriate to a civil administrator who works on the docks.
C_governor_halev.visualStatus: Locked to the released Rex Fleet Issue 1 likeness.
continuityLocks: Halev remains Verge tan-green, never Fleet dress blue
Stage him among cargo, workers, manifests, and failing infrastructure
His authority is practical proximity to the work

C_captain_naomi_sol.name: Captain Naomi Sol
C_captain_naomi_sol.voice: Blunt, sharp, proud; humor and impatience leak through under pressure.
C_captain_naomi_sol.arc: Resists dependence on Fleet while becoming a key partner in shared corridor operations.
C_captain_naomi_sol.visualAnchor: Lean Verge woman with dark hair pulled into a functional braid, a visible brow scar, and an intent, weathered face. Wears patched tan-and-muted-green escort gear with clear Verge markings in a cramped lived-in cockpit.
C_captain_naomi_sol.visualStatus: Locked to the released Rex Fleet Issue 1 likeness formerly developed under the Nira name.
continuityLocks: Naomi is Verge-coded in tan and green
Keep the dark braid and brow scar
Her cockpit and ship are smaller, patched, and operationally distinct from Thunderbreak

C_jex_marrin.name: Jex Marrin
C_jex_marrin.voice: Smooth, sardonic, transactional; wit is armor and tradecraft.
C_jex_marrin.arc: Gradually gives up informational and material advantage when secrecy and scarcity begin killing people.
C_jex_marrin.visualAnchor: Verge intermediary in a practical weathered travel cloak with stitched pockets and route seals. Anomaly-glass beads are sewn into the cloak and create subtle optical distortion, never magical glow. A fresh bandage wraps one rib beneath the layers.
C_jex_marrin.visualStatus: Recovered from approved Rex Fleet development; face, hair, facial hair, skin tone, and age remain unspecified.
continuityLocks: Jex is Verge-coded and operational, not an elderly market sage
Preserve the weathered pocketed travel cloak, route seals, anomaly-glass beads, and fresh rib bandage
The anomaly glass distorts light subtly and must not read as fantasy magic
Do not invent or lock age, hair, facial hair, or skin tone without an approved visual source
His sardonic wit lands while he continues working routes, manifests, and arbitration slates

C_elder_wallace.name: Brent Wallace
C_elder_wallace.arc: Serves as a cynical commerce voice rather than a moral center.

C_oren_pike.name: Oren Pike
C_oren_pike.voice: Charismatic, bombastic, performance-conscious; wants witnesses as much as results.
C_oren_pike.arc: Seeks legitimacy through spectacle, loses authority when restraint outperforms him, and is disabled by Billie at Auric Gate.

C_silent_triarch.name: The Silent Triarch
C_silent_triarch.arc: Preserves authority through scarcity, coercion, blockade, and information control.

C_luminara_mother.name: Luminara Mother
C_luminara_mother.arc: Keeps civilian cost visible inside corridor politics.

C_luminara_boy.name: Luminara Boy
C_luminara_boy.voice: Direct, curious, innocent without being precocious.
C_luminara_boy.arc: His questions expose stakes adults obscure.

C_archivist_selene_stormwell.name: Archivist Selene Stormwell
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.role: Fleet — Keeper of Memory, Stormwell Archive
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.arc: Turns cross-faction survival into institutional record rather than preserving a Fleet-only story.

C_jia_morgan.name: Jia Morgan
C_jia_morgan.voice: Precise, empirical, provisional; distinguishes measurement from theory.
C_jia_morgan.arc: Translates corridor and anomaly measurements into operational rules.

C_soren_kerr.name: Admiral Soren Kerr
C_soren_kerr.voice: Diplomatic, morally direct, politically seasoned; attentive to civilians and legitimacy.

C_silent_triarch_raid.name: Silent Triarch — Raid
C_silent_triarch_raid.voice: Sparse and imperative; frames seizure as survival.

C_silent_triarch_fear.name: Silent Triarch — Fear
C_silent_triarch_fear.voice: Sparse and clinical; treats fear as a governing instrument.

C_admiral_colin_rhyne.name: Admiral Colin Rhyne
C_admiral_colin_rhyne.voice: Practical, protective, integration-minded; favors Verge pilots in Fleet pickets and civilian access.

C_admiral_janet_keating.name: Admiral Janet Keating
C_admiral_janet_keating.voice: Force- and blockade-oriented; treats delay and civilian constraints as operational risk.

C_silent_triarch_trade.name: Silent Triarch — Trade
C_silent_triarch_trade.voice: Sparse and transactional; frames control as managed flow.

C_mara_vey.name: Dr. Mara Vey
C_mara_vey.role: Shard civilian — Tal Corvus physician and refugee witness
C_mara_vey.voice: Clinical without coldness; names people rather than abstractions and refuses propaganda from every faction.
C_mara_vey.arc: Protects her adolescent son Ilan and converts evidence of engineered deprivation into civilian political power on her own terms.
C_mara_vey.visualAnchor: Tal Corvus civilian physician in a worn pale field coat repaired with dark red utility stitching, portable diagnostic wrap, and smoke-marked medical satchel; tired hands remain precise under pressure.
C_mara_vey.visualStatus: New Issue 2 development; face, hair, skin tone, and age remain unspecified pending approved visual development.
continuityLocks: Mara is Ilan Vey's mother
Do not invent or lock facial traits without an approved visual source
Her medical work is physical and patient-centered, never generic console exposition

C_ilan_vey.name: Ilan Vey
C_ilan_vey.role: Shard civilian — adolescent engineering apprentice and refugee
C_ilan_vey.voice: Bright, frightened, observant; technical knowledge comes out as concrete problems and questions.
C_ilan_vey.arc: Is forced into responsibility during the escape and learns that his mother's testimony can protect strangers while endangering their remaining family.
C_ilan_vey.visualAnchor: Adolescent refugee in an oversized patched engineering layer with a battered repair slate, tool loops, and a healing injury supported by a practical brace.
C_ilan_vey.visualStatus: New Issue 2 development; face, hair, and skin tone remain unspecified pending approved visual development.
continuityLocks: Ilan is Mara Vey's adolescent son
Do not adultify him or turn him into a miniature officer
Keep the repair slate and visible injury consistent across Issues 2 and 3

C_sera_dain.name: Councilor Sera Dain
C_sera_dain.role: Verge — elected representative of Auric's overcrowded working districts
C_sera_dain.voice: Plainspoken, rigorous, locally accountable; supports refuge while forcing leaders to name who pays for it.
C_sera_dain.arc: Turns credible opposition into shared sacrifice and helps make Auric's civilian compact legitimate.
C_sera_dain.visualAnchor: Auric civic representative in durable tan-and-green work clothes beneath a simple council sash, carrying a scuffed district folio rather than ceremonial regalia.
C_sera_dain.visualStatus: New Issue 3 development; facial traits remain unspecified pending approved visual development.

C_tali_marrin.name: Tali Marrin
C_tali_marrin.role: Independent refuge keeper — Jex Marrin's younger sister
C_tali_marrin.voice: Dry, unsentimental, protective; understands the human cost hidden inside Jex's clever bargains.
C_tali_marrin.arc: Forces Jex to recognize that opening his private routes risks real families, including his own.
C_tali_marrin.visualAnchor: Practical refuge keeper in layered workwear with route seals turned inward, a compact emergency pack, and subtle anomaly-glass distortion matching Jex's network without copying his silhouette.
C_tali_marrin.visualStatus: New Issue 3 development; facial traits remain unspecified pending approved visual development.
continuityLocks: Tali is Jex Marrin's younger sister

C_resident_child.name: Auric Resident Child
C_resident_child.role: Verge civilian — child with a respiratory illness

C_listener.name: Civilian Listener
C_listener.role: Shard civilian receiving Mara Vey's testimony
